expansions.production: six derivative semantic SFX and two KokoClone oath sources

folderTaxonomy.numberingRule: BGM-01..04 are global state layers; SFX-SW/SP-01..03 are path semantic phases; VO-SW/SP-01 is the same protagonist's path oath

music.modelRole: historical creative brief and original candidates; these are not the four current runtime BGM files
music.execution: remote Kaggle Notebooks free Tesla T4 session only; no model inference on the player's workstation
music.disclosure: AI-generated candidate audio; no named artist imitation and no third-party reference audio

voice.model: KokoClone with Kokoro-ONNX multilingual TTS and Kanade voice conversion
voice.execution: remote Hugging Face cpu-basic Space; no model inference on the player's workstation
voice.modelRole: Mandarin protagonist candidate voice transferred from Kokoro's own synthetic zm_010 sample
voice.disclosure: AI-generated candidate voice; the reference is a model-provided synthetic sample, not a real person or actor

processing.creativeBoundary: models create audible content; deterministic tools only trim, crossfade, normalize, validate, hash and export
processing.runtimeFormat: PCM WAV, 16-bit, 24k-48kHz, mono for voice/SFX and stereo for BGM where the source supports it

bgm_sect.name: 山门初光
bgm_sect.timeOfDay: 破晓至清晨，日常选择之间的低压时段
bgm_sect.task: 宗门停留、普通事件阅读、路线整理与下一张卡牌判断
bgm_sect.scene: 青云山门、洞府、竹林与无明确危险的普通叙事场景
bgm_sect.playerPurpose: 给玩家留出阅读和权衡空间，同时维持修仙世界仍在呼吸的感觉
bgm_sect.keyScale: D minor pentatonic with an unresolved second
bgm_sect.structure: 4s air-and-bell pickup; 24s sparse two-phrase motif; 8s return to the opening air bed for looping
bgm_sect.prompt: Instrumental loop for a restrained early-morning xianxia sect in a 1990s PC-98-inspired card game. Sparse dry guqin-like plucks establish a two-note question, a breathy xiao answers only at phrase endings, a soft wooden temple block marks every second bar, and one distant bronze wind bell opens the horizon. 58 BPM, D minor pentatonic, intimate small ensemble, narrow but warm frequency range, clear space for Chinese narration and card UI, calm without becoming sleepy, loop ending must return to the same mountain-air texture as the opening. No vocals and no reference to any existing composition or artist.
bgm_sect.negativePrompt: No cinematic orchestra, no trailer riser, no pop drums, no choir, no EDM bass, no glossy new-age pad wall, no constant melody, no heroic climax, no thunder, no vinyl crackle, no spoken words, no abrupt ending.

bgm_combat.name: 灵息交锋
bgm_combat.timeOfDay: 昼夜皆可，普通战斗进入可操作状态后的持续压力时段
bgm_combat.task: 阅读敌方计划、安排手牌顺序、保留真元并完成普通战斗
bgm_combat.scene: 山道、宗门演武场、秘境与普通遭遇的回合制牌组战斗
bgm_combat.playerPurpose: 让回合节奏保持向前，但不掩盖出牌、命中、护盾和反应窗口短音效
bgm_combat.structure: 8-bar restrained pulse; second 8 bars add one bowed counterline; final 4 bars remove the counterline and close on the opening pulse
bgm_combat.prompt: Instrumental tactical combat loop for a turn-based xianxia deck battle in a 1990s PC-98-inspired game. A muted pipa-like two-note ostinato at 96 BPM, low Chinese frame drum on restrained downbeats, dry bamboo clacks that leave gaps for card SFX, and a short bowed-string pulse that appears only in the middle phrase. E minor pentatonic, tense and analytical rather than frantic, small ensemble, dry close sound, clear transient space, steady loop that supports repeated card decisions without fatigue. No vocals and no imitation of any existing game soundtrack or artist.
bgm_combat.negativePrompt: No modern drum kit, no taiko wall, no distorted guitar, no EDM arpeggiator, no brass fanfare, no choir, no cinematic impacts, no continuous cymbal wash, no melody covering combat SFX, no victory cadence, no abrupt fade.

bgm_boss.name: 劫脉压境
bgm_boss.timeOfDay: 雷云遮光的暮夜，首领战与阶段变化的高压时段
bgm_boss.task: 识别首领计划、承受阶段转位并保留资源完成终结回合
bgm_boss.scene: 境界守门、雷劫、宗门强敌与带阶段机制的首领战场
bgm_boss.playerPurpose: 建立重量和不可逆风险，同时保留敌方计划、反应提示与终结动作的可听空间
bgm_boss.keyScale: C minor with open fifth drone
bgm_boss.timeSignature: 6/8 perceived over a slow 3/4 ground pulse
instrumentation: deep Chinese war drum played sparsely
bgm_boss.structure: 6s low open-fifth warning; 20s three-pulse boss motif with one bell per cycle; 10s remove the top layer and return to the warning drone
bgm_boss.prompt: Instrumental boss loop for a severe xianxia realm gate under dark thunder clouds in a 1990s PC-98-inspired card game. Slow 72 BPM weight, sparse deep Chinese war drum in a three-pulse pattern, low bowed strings holding an open fifth, one large bronze bell at the end of each cycle, dry stone percussion for mechanism changes, and a distant controlled thunder-texture drone. C minor, grave and oppressive but never a modern trailer, clear gaps for enemy plans and reaction cues, no final resolution, ending returns to the opening low warning for a seamless loop. No vocals and no named-style imitation.
bgm_boss.negativePrompt: No Hollywood trailer boom, no massive orchestra, no choir, no fast double drums, no metal guitar, no EDM sub drop, no constant thunder crashes, no triumphant brass, no jump-scare sting, no clipping, no abrupt ending.

bgm_mystery.name: 因果回纹
bgm_mystery.timeOfDay: 无明确钟点的暮色夹层，因果、突破与真相显形时段
bgm_mystery.task: 阅读因果回执、判断突破风险、理解旧选择如何改变当前可能性
bgm_mystery.scene: 因果种子呈现、境界突破、碎玉共鸣、真相图谱与结局候选界面
bgm_mystery.playerPurpose: 让玩家感到过去正在返回，但不暗示某个选项一定正确或必然成功
bgm_mystery.keyScale: F-sharp minor pentatonic with suspended fourth
bgm_mystery.structure: 5s isolated stone chimes; 19s suspended three-plus-two motif; 8s dissolve to the same water-and-metal bed as the opening
bgm_mystery.prompt: Instrumental mystery and causality loop for a xianxia card game's breakthrough, karma and revealed-truth scenes, with restrained 1990s PC-98-inspired timbre. 54 BPM perceived as a free three-plus-two pulse, soft stone chimes separated by silence, breathy low xiao fragments, one bowed metal harmonic, a subtle reversed-zither breath used only as a transition, and quiet water resonance. F-sharp minor pentatonic with a suspended fourth, intimate and uncanny rather than frightening, ambiguous outcome, generous space for text and one-shot cues, ending dissolves back into the opening water-and-metal texture. No vocals and no existing-style imitation.
bgm_mystery.negativePrompt: No horror drone, no whispering voices, no jump scare, no glittering fantasy arpeggio, no choir, no cinematic swell, no pop beat, no excessive reverb wash, no clear happy or tragic resolution, no abrupt fade.

sword.name: 剑修·藏锋接式
sword.playerFantasy: 不是每次都重砍，而是试锋、收锋、接住上一式留下的风线
timbre: two-step metal harmonic only on state payoff
sword.rhythm: short-long alternation; attack onset is immediate, payoff leaves a small breath for the next card
sword.frequencyFocus: 1.8-6kHz transient with restrained low-mid body; no sub impact
avoid: long fantasy shimmer on every hit
metallic cue that masks damage readability

attackStart.prompt: A single close dry Chinese straight-sword draw followed by a narrow controlled air slice, fast hand movement, small wooden scabbard stop, crisp steel transient, no impact and no musical tail; restrained xianxia game SFX with a readable start within 40 milliseconds.
attackStart.negativePrompt: No heavy greatsword, no explosion, no whoosh wall, no orchestra, no voice, no magic sparkle, no long reverb, no second strike.

impact.name: 一点命中

impact.negativePrompt: No giant clang, no anvil, no gore, no explosion, no multiple hits, no bass drop, no crowd, no long ringing tail, no musical phrase.

statePayoff.prompt: A short wooden scabbard catch, then two faint cold steel harmonics a perfect fourth apart, the second slightly quieter, suggesting sword intent stored for the next move; intimate dry xianxia status confirmation with a silent gap after the catch.
statePayoff.negativePrompt: No full melody, no bell choir, no magical sparkle shower, no victory fanfare, no impact boom, no voice, no long ambient wash, no repeated loop.

pathOath.subtitle: 剑锋只出一线，余势留给下一式。

pathOath.negativePrompt: No elderly timbre, no opera cadence, no announcer voice, no shouting, no whisper, no imitation of a real actor, no path-specific actor change.
